title: Stories and clauses
summary: Compound tenses, the evidential `-mIş`, and the participles, verbal nouns and converbs that Turkish uses instead of subordinate clauses.
canDo: Tell a story in the past, with background, earlier events and things you only heard about
Describe people and things with relative clauses
Link actions with when, by, without, because and as soon as
Set conditions, use the passive and the causative, and report what someone said
